title: Cosmic Skeleton Vision
description: A skeletal figure in a yellow jacket and ornate helmet sits cross-legged on a giant cracked white flower in a dark pond, its glowing orange eyes staring forward as beams of light shine down from a massive cracked cosmic egg floating above. The egg reveals green horses and a green-haired woman within, set against a swirling fiery sky with stars, while the pond contains lily pads, glowing flowers, and butterflies in a dense forest setting.
